name: neon-soul
description: NEON SOUL - roguelite de accion arcade cyberpunk. HTML5 Canvas + Web Audio, sin dependencias.

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
